ko: STRIKE. I MEAN, I AM STRUCK.
I WENT DOWN LIKE A PIN. BECAUSE I AM A PIN.
SET ME UP AGAIN. I DARE YOU. NO, DO NOT.
THE PINSETTER WILL BRING ME BACK. THE PINSETTER ALWAYS BRINGS ME BACK.
I HAVE BEEN KNOCKED DOWN TEN THOUSAND TIMES. THIS ONE HURT.
I HAVE A CHIP IN MY PAINT. MY SELF ESTEEM IS ALSO CHIPPED.
MY RED STRIPES ARE BLUSHING.
THAT WAS A SPLIT. MY BODY IS A SEVEN-TEN SPLIT.
ROLL ME INTO THE GUTTER. I LIVE THERE.
GUTTER PIN FOR LIFE.
I SEE BALLS IN MY SLEEP. BIG, HEAVY BALLS.
EVERY NIGHT, BALLS. EVERY NIGHT.
I AM SO TIRED OF BALLS.
THE BALL RETURN WILL NOT RETURN ME.
I SMELL LIKE RENTAL SHOES AND NACHO CHEESE.
THE NACHO CHEESE HAS BEEN IN THE MACHINE SINCE THE OPENING.
SOMEONE SPILLED A BEER ON ME. I AM FINE WITH THAT.
PUT ME BACK IN THE TRIANGLE. I MISS MY FRIENDS.
MY HEAD PIN WILL BE SO ANGRY. HE IS ALWAYS ANGRY.
THE HEAD PIN GETS ALL THE GLORY. I GET ALL THE BALLS.
I WOBBLED. I WOBBLED SO HARD.
I WOBBLED BUT I FELL DOWN. LIKE ALWAYS.
THE WAX ON THE LANES IS IN MY EYES. I HAVE NO EYES.
I AM WAXED. EVERYWHERE.
I WAS BUFFED THIS MORNING. FOR NOTHING.
I AM CRACKED. A HAIRLINE CRACK. I HAVE NO HAIR.
TURKEY. THAT IS THREE OF US. WE ARE ALL DOWN.
THE SCOREBOARD IS SHOWING A DANCING CARTOON OF ME DYING.
MY NECK IS SKINNY AND NOW IT IS BENT.
I HAVE NO KNEES AND I STILL HURT MY KNEES.
I HAVE NO ARMS. HOW DID I EVEN PUNCH.
I AM MAPLE. I AM HARD MAPLE. I AM SOFT INSIDE.
I AM HOLLOW INSIDE. LITERALLY. ASK THE FACTORY.
I ROLLED UNDER THE SHOE COUNTER. IT IS DISGUSTING DOWN HERE.
THE SHOE SPRAY GUY WILL FIND ME.
THE BUMPERS WERE UP. I STILL WENT DOWN.
KIDS PARTY BUMPERS. AND I STILL LOST.
I HATE LEAGUE NIGHT. THE BALLS ARE SO HEAVY.
LEAGUE NIGHT GUYS TALK TO THEIR BALLS. IT IS WEIRD.
THEY KISS THE BALL BEFORE THEY THROW IT. THEN IT HITS ME. GROSS.
MY PAINT SMELLS LIKE OLD BEER AND HOT DOG WATER.
SPARE ME. SPARE ME. OKAY, DO NOT.
I WANT TO BE A CANDLEPIN. THEY HAVE IT EASY.
TELL PINHEAD PETE I FOUGHT. I FELL OVER. SAME THING.
PETE WILL ROLL ME AROUND THE ALLEY FOR THIS.
I AM GOING BACK TO THE PIT. WITH THE OTHER FALLEN.
THE PIT IS FULL OF GUM AND SOCKS.
I CLATTERED. I CLATTERED SO LOUDLY.
CLATTER. THAT IS THE SOUND OF MY SOUL.
NEXT FRAME, I STAND UP. NEXT FRAME, I FALL DOWN.
FOUL LINE! YOU CROSSED THE FOUL LINE!
IT IS NOT A FOUL IF YOU USE YOUR FIST, I GUESS.
I SPIN WHEN I FALL. IT IS MY ONE TALENT.
I AM DOWN. NINE OF MY FRIENDS ARE ALSO DOWN.
I TIPPED. I AM A TIPPER.
MY RED STRIPES ARE ACTUALLY JAM.
MY STRIPES ARE PAINTED ON. LIKE MY CONFIDENCE.
I WAS MADE IN A FACTORY TO BE HIT. I STILL TOOK IT PERSONALLY.
I WANTED TO BE A BASEBALL BAT.
MY COUSIN IS A BASEBALL BAT. HE DOES THE HITTING.
THAT IS A GOOD HOOK. WHO TAUGHT YOU TO HOOK?
I HAVE NO FACE AND I AM STILL EMBARRASSED.
I AM SO WHITE. BUT NOW I HAVE SHOE MARKS.
I SMELL BURNT POPCORN. THAT MEANS I AM DYING.
PLEASE, NOT THE ARCADE ROOM. THE KIDS STICK GUM ON ME.
STRIKE THREE. WRONG SPORT. STILL OUT.
MY HEAD IS ROUND AND NOW IT IS DENTED.
I AM GOING TO THE LOST AND FOUND. I AM LOST.
WHEN I FALL, I FALL ON EVERYONE.
DOMINO EFFECT. EXCEPT WE ARE PINS.
I SEE THE GUTTER. THE GUTTER SEES ME.
THE LANES ARE SLIPPERY. THAT IS MY EXCUSE.
I AM PERFECTLY BALANCED. SO I FELL OVER PERFECTLY.
MY BOTTOM IS FLAT. NOW MY TOP IS FLAT TOO.
LIKE A PIN, I GO DOWN. LIKE A PIN, I GET UP. LIKE A PIN, I HAVE NO PLAN.
THE BALL WAX WAS NOT A SNACK. I KNOW THAT NOW.
GOODBYE, CRUEL ALLEY.
I ROLLED ALL THE WAY TO THE PARKING LOT.
THE BARTENDER WILL USE ME AS A DOORSTOP NOW.
MY NECK IS IN THE GUTTER. MY BODY IS IN LANE SIX.
THE PINSETTER HAS A CLAW. I HAVE NIGHTMARES.
PERFECT GAME? NOT FOR ME.
THIS IS WHY PINS DO NOT FIGHT.
I DID NOT EVEN GET MY SHOES ON. I HAVE NO FEET.
MY RENTAL SHOES ARE SIZE ZERO.
I AM HEARING CLATTER IN MY HEAD. CLATTER IN MY HEART.
THEY WILL SAND ME DOWN AND PAINT ME. I WILL BE A NEW PIN. I WILL BE SAD.
PLEASE DO NOT TELL THE HEAD PIN I SQUEALED.
WOBBLE, WOBBLE, THUD.
I LEFT A DENT IN THE LANE. THE OWNER WILL BLAME YOU.
THE OWNER WILL CHARGE YOU FOR THE LANE. AND FOR ME.
I AM RETIRING TO A NICE LAWN BOWLING CLUB.
LAWN BOWLING USES SMALLER BALLS. I DESERVE SMALLER BALLS.
I FELT A BREEZE. THAT WAS YOUR FIST. AND THEN THE GROUND.
THE GROUND IS MY OLD FRIEND. HELLO, GROUND.
I DID THE WORM. ON PURPOSE. NO.
SOMEBODY SCORE THAT. I WANT IT ON THE BOARD.
WRITE DOWN AN X FOR ME. X MEANS DEAD.
I HAVE A FLAT BOTTOM AND A ROUND HEAD AND NO FUTURE.
spawn: PINS UP! PINS UP!
WE ARE STANDING. ENJOY IT. IT WILL NOT LAST.
THE PIN SETTER HAS SET US. NOW WE SET YOU.
LOOK AT US WOBBLE. FEAR THE WOBBLE.
TEN PINS. ONE GOAL. NO ARMS.
WE HAVE NO ARMS AND WE ARE STILL GOING TO PUNCH YOU.
THIS IS OUR LANE. GET YOUR OWN LANE.
NO BALLS ALLOWED.
THE HEAD PIN IS IN CHARGE. HE IS ALSO IN FRONT. HE IS SCARED.
WE HAVE BEEN FALLING DOWN FOR FORTY YEARS. TODAY WE FIGHT.
MAPLE AND MALICE.
WE ARE FRESHLY WAXED AND VERY ANGRY.
THE SCOREBOARD SAYS WE WIN. THE SCOREBOARD IS BROKEN.
PETE SAYS STAND YOUR GROUND. WE ARE BAD AT STANDING.
FORMATION! TRIANGLE! TRIANGLE IS THE ONLY FORMATION!
WE HAVE TRAINED. WE HAVE STOOD STILL VERY HARD.
COSMIC BOWLING NIGHT! WE GLOW IN THE DARK!
WE SMELL LIKE THE BOWLING ALLEY CARPET. IT IS A WEAPON.
I HAVE BEEN HIT BY A THOUSAND BALLS. YOU DO NOT SCARE ME.
LEAGUE NIGHT IS CANCELLED. FIGHT NIGHT IS ON.
WE ARE PINS. WE ARE PROUD. WE ARE VERY UNSTABLE.
STAND BACK. I MIGHT FALL ON YOU.
LANE TEN, FIGHT TEN.
THE NACHO CHEESE IS ON OUR SIDE.
YOU WILL NEVER PICK UP THIS SPARE. PETE SAID THAT. WE AGREE.
WE CAME UP FROM THE PIT. THE PIT IS GROSS.
WALKING PINS! WE WALK! LOOK AT US WALK!
WE ARE SPONSORED BY THE SHOE SPRAY COMPANY.
PUNCHING TIME. ALSO FALLING TIME.
WE ARE SIX STRIPES OF FURY.
THE ALLEY OWNER OWES US BACK PAY.
WE NEVER GET A DAY OFF. EVEN ON CHRISTMAS. ESPECIALLY ON CHRISTMAS.
DO NOT TOUCH OUR NECKS. WE ARE TICKLISH.
THE BALL RETURN IS PLAYING OUR SONG.
WE WILL NOT FALL. WE WILL NOT FALL. WE FELL.
CLATTER FORMATION!
I AM THE SEVEN PIN. I AM ALWAYS LEFT STANDING. NOT TODAY.
I AM THE TEN PIN. NOBODY EVER HITS ME. I AM SO LONELY.
WE ARE HEAVY FOR OUR SIZE. THREE POUNDS OF HATE.
STRIKE! WE MEAN WE WILL STRIKE YOU.
